LanguageData.FCSettingWorkerProductionBaseBonusTip: A flat bonus (or penalty) added to every settlement's per-worker resource production base.
LanguageData.FCSettingWorkerProductionMultBonusTip: A multiplier applied to every settlement's per-worker resource production multiplier.
LanguageData.FCSettingTimerTip: Scales how long this timer takes.
LanguageData.FCSettingEnableSettlementCaptureTip: When enabled (default), defeating a hostile settlement with your own colonists lets you choose to capture it as one of your Empire's settlements instead of only razing it. The captured tile becomes an Empire settlement once your colonists leave the base.
LanguageData.FCSettingAntiExploitTip: When enabled (default), mercenary weapons and apparel are biocoded to their wielder, and humanlike mercenaries receive a death acidifier implant that dissolves their worn gear when they die, so you can't farm free gear from your own squads.
LanguageData.FCSettingRestrictDefenseMapLootTip: When enabled (default), a settlement's own items are forbidden and locked on manual defense maps, so you can't freely take their items. You still keep your own pawns and their gear, recover your fallen reinforcements, and may take spoils dropped by dead attackers.
LanguageData.FCSettingConfigureEvents: Enable or disable individual events below. Disabled events will not fire in any save.
LanguageData.FCSettingAdvancedWarn: Advanced tuning for settlement drift rates. The defaults match the mod's intended balance.
LanguageData.FCSettingRoadBuilderDesc:
The Road Builder automatically connects your Empire settlements with roads using a Minimum Spanning Tree algorithm, which is recalculated (with caching) on the following events: - each time a settlement is founded or lost - when you research a new level of roads
This requires computing pathfinding costs between many pairs of settlements, which can be expensive with many settlements, or with very sparse settlements.
By default, this computation runs on a background thread to avoid freezing the game. If you experience issues with threading, you can disable it and optionally spread the computation across multiple ticks instead.
Spreading out the computation will reduce the impact on performance, but no roads will build until the MST is fully constructed. So the more you throttle the algorithm, the longer it will take for your roads to start building.
LanguageData.FCSettingBlockEventsDuringChain: Block new events during an active chain
LanguageData.FCSettingBlockEventsDuringChainDesc: While a multi-step event chain is still resolving, do not fire a new random event even if the time-between-events would allow it. Overrides the frequency setting.
LanguageData.FCSettingBattleModeTip:
How battles are fought when an enemy attacks one of your settlements.

Auto-Resolve: the outcome is decided by simulated rolls, no map.
Manual: a real map is generated and you defend it in combat.
Hybrid: auto-resolves unless you send a caravan to the settlement and start the battle by clicking the "Defend" gizmo.
LanguageData.FCSettingOffenseBattleModeTip:
How your offensive operations (raid, capture, enslave) against enemy settlements are fought.

Auto-Resolve: the outcome is decided by simulated rolls, no map.
Manual: the enemy settlement's map is generated and you assault it in combat, using the squad that you sent on the attack. Shares the concurrent-battle-map limit with defense.
LanguageData.FCBattleModeManualDesc: All battles generate a map for manual combat.
LanguageData.FCBattleModeHybridDesc: Battles auto-resolve unless you send a caravan to defend.
LanguageData.FCOffenseBattleModeManualDesc: Offensive operations generate the enemy settlement's map for manual combat.
LanguageData.FCSettingMinMaxMilitaryAction: Min/Max Days Until Military Action (ex. Settlements being attacked)
LanguageData.FCSettingMaxConcurrentBattleMapsTip: Maximum number of manual defense battle maps that can be open simultaneously across all settlements. Set to 0 for unlimited. Additional battles beyond this limit will auto-resolve.
LanguageData.FCSettingDefenseMapBaseSizeTip: Base edge length (in cells) of manually-defended settlement battle maps. Final size = base + (settlement level * per-level step), clamped between the minimum and maximum below.
LanguageData.FCSettingDefenseMapPerLevelStepTip: How many cells the defense map grows for each settlement level above the base size.
LanguageData.FCSettingDefenseMapMinSizeTip: Hard floor (in cells) for the defense map edge length, regardless of base/step settings.
LanguageData.FCSettingDefenseMapMaxSizeTip: Hard cap (in cells) for the defense map edge length.
LanguageData.FCSettingEfficiencyDamping: Efficiency Combat Influence (0 = HP only, 1 = full roll effect)
LanguageData.FCSettingEfficiencyDampingTooltip:
Controls how much the military efficiency stat affects auto-resolve battle outcomes.
At 0, military efficiency affects only the effective level of both forces.
At 1, military efficiency fully affects each round of auto combat. Military forces of lower level but higher efficiency can often beat forces of a higher level, but lower efficiency.
Values in between dampen the effect of military efficiency on the auto combat.
LanguageData.FCSettingMercHealRateTip: Multiplier on the healing rate for off-map mercenaries. At 1.0 (default), an Empire merc heals at roughly the same per-day rate as a vanilla pawn in a basic bed being tended with industrial medicine by an unskilled doctor. Higher values heal faster; lower values heal slower.
LanguageData.FCSettingMechRepairRateTip: Hit points repaired per hourly heal tick for off-map bonded mechs. Mechs use a separate repair path from mercenaries and animals. At 0, mechs do not auto-repair and must be paid-replaced once damaged enough.
LanguageData.FCSettingPsylinkCostMultTip: Multiplier on the silver cost added to a unit design per psylink level. At 1.0 (default), each level costs roughly the value of one psylink neuroformer.
LanguageData.FCSettingMechCostMultTip: Multiplier on the silver cost added to a mechanitor unit design per assigned mech. At 1.0 (default), each mech costs roughly its market value.
LanguageData.FCSettingMechlinkCostTip: Flat silver cost added to a unit design for making it a mechanitor (the mechlink itself), on top of per-mech costs. Default 1000 ~ the value of a mechlink.
LanguageData.FCSettingPsycastCostMultTip: Multiplier applied to all per-point costs related to psycasting. Set to 0 to make everything free.
LanguageData.FCSettingsCompatNone: No supported compatibility patches are active.
LanguageData.FCSettingsCompatVPEDesc: With VPE active, psylink levels themselves are free. Instead, each point spent in the psycast editor (psycasts, meditation foci, stat upgrades) adds to a unit's cost. Tune those per-point costs here.
LanguageData.FCSettingVPEBasePsycastCostTip: Flat silver cost of each chosen psycast, before adding the per-level amount below.
LanguageData.FCSettingVPEPerLevelCostTip: Additional silver cost per psycast tier (level). A tier-3 psycast costs the base plus three times this amount.
LanguageData.FCSettingVPEFocusCostTip: Silver cost of each unlocked meditation focus type.
LanguageData.FCSettingVPEStatPointCostTip: Silver cost of each psycaster stat point spent.
LanguageData.FCSettingApplyAutoResolveInjuries: Apply injuries and deaths from auto-resolved battles
LanguageData.FCSettingApplyAutoResolveInjuriesTip: When enabled, the abstract force losses from an auto-resolved battle are converted into real injuries (and potentially deaths) on the participating mercenary pawns. When disabled, auto-resolve never touches squad pawns.
LanguageData.FCSettingAutoResolveDeathThresholdTip: If the squad's casualty rate is below this threshold, then no members of the squad will die. At 75% (default), only squads that lose 75% or more of their force will see deaths.
LanguageData.FCSettingAutoResolveMaxDeathFractionTip: The maximum fraction of casualties that become deaths. At 50% (default), roughly 50% the squad's injured pawns will die.
LanguageData.FCSettingCrushingDefeatPenaltyMultiplier: Multiplies the settlement-side penalties (prosperity, happiness, loyalty, building destruction chance) when a settlement suffers a Crushing Defeat: a defense where your forces failed to inflict a single casualty.
LanguageData.FCSettingOverwhelmingVictoryRewardMultip: Multiplies the happiness/loyalty bonus granted to the winning squad's home settlement after an Overwhelming Victory: a battle won without taking a single casualty. Set to 0 to disable the reward (the flavor letter still appears).
LanguageData.FCSettingRespectLethalDamageThresholdTip: When enabled (default), auto-resolve injuries are capped so cumulative injury severity stays under Rimworld's lethal-damage threshold and the injury path can't accidentally kill a pawn. Disable when running mods that remove or relax this check.
LanguageData.FCSettingMaxSquadSizeTip: Hard cap on mercenaries per squad. Existing templates retain their existing slot count when this is changed; only newly-created templates and new hires use the new value. Per-settlement bonuses (from buildings/policies) still stack on top.
LanguageData.FCSettingMaxAnimalSubpawnsTip: Maximum companion animals a single mercenary design can carry. Adding past this is blocked; lowering it never removes animals from existing designs.
LanguageData.FCSettingMaxAnimalSubpawnsGiddyUpTip: Maximum companion animals a single mercenary design can carry. Adding past this is blocked; lowering it never removes animals from existing designs. With Giddy Up 2, a merc's separate mount does not count toward this limit.
LanguageData.FCSettingSquadHireCostMultiplierTip: Multiplier applied to a template's full equipment cost when the player hires a fresh squad. 1.0 = sticker price; 0.0 = free; higher values make hiring more expensive.
LanguageData.FCSettingSquadUpgradeCostMultiplierTip: Multiplier applied to the difference in cost between a hired squad's current loadout and its source template when the player upgrades the squad to match.
LanguageData.FCSettingSquadDeploymentCostPercentageTi:
Percentage of a squad's current equipment value billed in silver each time it is deployed (sent to a player map or on an offensive operation). Defensive operations are free.
The cost becomes a bill against the squad's home settlement, due after the lifespan setting expires.
0% disables the cost.
LanguageData.FCSettingDeploymentBillLifespanTip: Number of days a deployment-cost bill remains payable before it expires and the settlement takes the late- or unpaid-bill penalty. Independent of the tax cycle.
LanguageData.FCSettingSquadRestockCostPercentageTip:
Percentage of the market value of carried inventory (ammo, medicine, drugs) a surviving merc actually used up in a manual battle that is billed in silver to restock it. The items are automatically refilled to the squad's loadout regardless.
Only manual battles consume inventory; auto-resolved battles incur no restock charge. The cost becomes a bill against the squad's home settlement, due after the deployment bill lifespan expires.
0% disables the cost.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueHelpText: Weights controlling how a xenotype's genes inflate the cost of a mercenary template. Final cost factor is 1 + (sum of weighted per-gene contributions).
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueWeightMvfTip: Weight on the offset from a gene's marketValueFactor: values > 1 (e.g. Deathless, FireSpew) increase price; values < 1 decrease it.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueWeightMetTip: Weight per point of negative metabolism on a gene.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueWeightArcTip: Weight per archite required by a gene.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueWeightEffectsTip: Weight on a gene's category-weighted stat factors, stat offsets, capacity modifiers, and skill aptitudes. Combat-category stats count most; social stats and unknown categories count nothing.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueWeightPainTip: Weight on a gene's pain-factor change. Pain reduction raises price, and vice versa.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueWeightDmgResistTip: Weight on a gene's damage-type factors. Resistance raises price, and vice versa.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueFactorUnlimitedTip: When enabled (default), the xenotype cost factor has no upper bound. Disable to clamp the final factor at a configurable maximum.
LanguageData.FCSettingGeneValueMaxFactorTip: Hard ceiling on the xenotype cost factor when the uncapped option is off. The cost multiplier applied to a unit template's base xenotype cost will never exceed this value.
LanguageData.FCSettingUseThreadedRoadComputationDesc: Computes road paths on a background thread for better performance. Disable this if you experience issues with road building.
LanguageData.FCSettingEdgesPerRoadTickTip: How many road graph edges to process per tick when computing on the main thread. Set to 0 for unlimited (fastest, but may cause stutter).
LanguageData.FCSettingRoadBuildIntervalTip: How many days pass between each road-building step. Lower values build roads more often; higher values slow construction. The Road Builders policy builds roughly three times faster than this.
LanguageData.FCMirrorPlayerTechLevelDesc: When enabled, the Empire faction's tech level is pinned to the player faction's tech level. Research projects no longer advance the Empire's tech level.
LanguageData.FCDifficultyPeacefulDesc: For players who want a relaxed empire management experience with generous resource gains and frequent tax collection.
LanguageData.FCDifficultyCommunityBuilderDesc: Easy difficulty with good resource gains and moderate tax frequency.
LanguageData.FCDifficultyAdventureStoryDesc: Balanced difficulty for most players.Moderate resource gains with reasonable tax intervals.
LanguageData.FCDifficultyStriveToSurviveDesc: Challenging difficulty with reduced resources and longer tax intervals.
LanguageData.FCDifficultyBloodAndDustDesc: Hard difficulty with limited resources and infrequent tax collection.
LanguageData.FCDifficultyLosingIsFunDesc: Brutal difficulty for masochists. Minimal resources and very long tax intervals.
LanguageData.FCResetCapitalLocationWarning: Please reset your capital location. If you continue to see this after reseting, please report it.
LanguageData.FCTaxMapNotSetWarning: Your tax map has not been set. Please set it using the faction menu.
LanguageData.FCAutoResolveDisabledWarning: Manual or Hybrid battle mode is active. If you encounter map generation errors, switch back to Auto-Resolve.
LanguageData.FCManualDefenseWarningDesc: Manual and Hybrid battle modes generate maps for settlement defense. If you encounter issues, switch to Auto-Resolve mode in settings.
LanguageData.FCTaxDeliveryNotSetWarning: No tax delivery location set. Either set a tax delivery map or enable tax delivery on a tax spot.
LanguageData.FCCapitalNotSetWarning: No empire capital established. Either use 'Set Capital' in the Empire menu or build and activate a Capital Seat.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerDurationDaysTip: How many days hired laborers stay before returning home.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerCooldownDaysTip: Days you must wait between laborer hires.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerBaseCountTip: Number of laborers sent regardless of empire size.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerPerSettlementTip: Extra laborers added for each settlement in your empire.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerMaxCountTip: Upper limit on how many laborers a single hire can send.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerSkillBonusPerLevelTip: Skill levels added to each laborer per point of average settlement level above 1. Set to 0 to disable quality scaling.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerSkillBonusCapTip: Maximum total skill-level bonus a laborer can receive from settlement-level scaling.
LanguageData.FCSettingLaborerCostPerDay: Silver cost per laborer per day
